_description: Cross-SDK DCP-09 §3.5.2 mandate chain time vectors. Every chain verifier MUST accept each must_accept chain (root first) and report expected.depth and expected.effective_tier, and MUST reject each must_reject chain with an error that contains error_contains (case-insensitive), verified at the case verification_time (else verification_time) against the case keys (else keys) with revoked_mandate_ids revoked. Windows, nesting in the parent window and the expires_at of the signer keys of both slots are RFC 3339 instants of the subset of interop_vectors.json#rfc3339, compared in milliseconds and never as text, both limits included; year 0000 and offsets crossing year 0000 or 9999 are instants like any other. Every signature is real (Ed25519 + ML-DSA-65, pq_over_classical): the root by the human, the sub-mandate by the root agent. Key material is synthetic, generated for these vectors only.
